scenes.name: Classroom Window & Morning Chime
scenes.subtitle: Soft nostalgic piano prelude • Morning sunlight streaming through dusty school windowpanes

scenes.name: Subah Ki Jaldi & Homework Ke Bahaane
scenes.subtitle: Running to school in half-fastened uniform • An entire universe inside one small classroom

lines.text: Woh subah ki jaldi, woh bhaag ke jaana,
Woh aadha sa homework, bahana banana...
Woh khidki se aati dhoop ka safar,
Woh ghar se bhi pyaara lagta tha ghar...
Haan, ek chhoti si duniya thi,
Jismein saara jahaan tha...

scenes.name: Bag Mein Kitaabein & Tiffin Ki Daawat
scenes.subtitle: Marbles in pockets, big dreams in heart • Stolen laughter behind the teacher's back

lines.text: Bag mein kitaabein, jeb mein kanche,
Dil mein the kitne iraade,
Teacher ke aate hi chup ho jaana,
Phir peeche se hansna, chhupke se baatein...
Tiffin khula toh sab saath baithe,
Apna bhi aadha, tera bhi aadha,
Jis din jo laaya, sabka hi hota,
Chhota sa lunch bhi lagta tha daawat...

scenes.name: Befikr Hansi & Pure Dosti
scenes.subtitle: No fear of tomorrow, laughing wholeheartedly at the smallest jokes

lines.text: Na kal ki fikrein, na aaj ka darr,
Woh chhoti si baaton pe hansna jee bhar...

scenes.name: Ek Ghanti Thi, Sau Kahaaniyan
scenes.sectionTag: 05 // MUKHDA  •  DIL REH GAYA CLASSROOM MEIN
scenes.subtitle: We walked all the way back home • But our hearts remained in that classroom

lines.text: Ek ghanti thi, sau kahaaniyan,
Ek bench thi, poora jahaan,
Hum toh ghar tak aa gaye,
Dil reh gaya classroom mein wahaan...
Woh pencil ke tukde, woh kaagaz ke jahaan,
Woh doston ke chehre, woh beete imtihaan,
Aaj bhi aankhein band karun toh dikhe,
Mera school, mere log, mera bachpan wahaan...
Ek ghanti thi, sau kahaaniyan,
Dil reh gaya classroom mein wahaan...

scenes.name: Acoustic Interlude & Empty Corridors
scenes.subtitle: Gentle acoustic guitar swells • Empty school corridors bathed in afternoon golden hour

scenes.name: Baarish Mein Bheegna & Muddy Shoes
scenes.subtitle: Drenched in monsoon downpours after school • Names carved on the last bench

lines.text: Yaad hai woh din jab baarish mein humne,
Chhutti ke baad bhi bheegna tha chaha,
Geeli si shirt aur mitti ke jooton mein,
Ghar jaake daant bhi hanske tha khaana...
Woh last wali bench pe naam likhna,
Woh ek hi joke pe sau baar hansna,
Woh dost jo bolta, “Kal milte hain phir,”
Kisko pata tha badal jaayega sab kuchh...

scenes.name: Tasveeron Ke Chehre & Unfading Days
scenes.subtitle: Faces now framed in old photographs • Years pass, but those memories never fade

lines.text: Kuchh bade sapne, kuchh kacchi si baatein,
Kuchh chehre jo ab tasveeron mein aate,
Kitne hi saal yun guzarte gaye,
Par woh din kahin dil se guzarte nahin...

scenes.name: Ek Ghanti Thi (Reprise)
scenes.subtitle: Pencil fragments and paper airplanes • Childhood echoes in the stillness of the heart

lines.text: Ek ghanti thi, sau kahaaniyan,
Ek bench thi, poora jahaan,
Hum toh ghar tak aa gaye,
Dil reh gaya classroom mein wahaan...
Woh pencil ke tukde, woh kaagaz ke jahaan,
Woh doston ke chehre, woh beete imtihaan,
Aaj bhi aankhein band karun toh dikhe,
Mera school, mere log,脉 mera bachpan wahaan...
Ek ghanti thi, sau kahaaniyan,
Dil reh gaya classroom mein wahaan...

scenes.name: Aakhri Din & Present Ma'am
scenes.sectionTag: 10 // BRIDGE  •  THE FINAL DAY & ROLL CALL
scenes.subtitle: Signatures on school bags • If only someone called my name in roll call once again

lines.text: Us aakhri din bhi hum hanse the bahut,
Kisi ne na socha, yeh aakhri milan hai,
Woh bags pe likhe hue waade puraane,
Woh “contact mein rehna” ke saare fasaane...
Tasveer mein sabke chehre toh hain,
Par woh roz milne ke din ab kahaan hain?
Kaash koi darwaaza khul jaaye phir se,
Wahi uniform ho, wahi dost hon paas,
Attendance mein jab mera naam koi le,
Main “Present, ma'am!” bol doon ek baar...
Aur phir se woh ghanti baje...
Aur kuchh bhi na badla ho khaas...

scenes.name: Cinematic Strings & Instrumental Swell
scenes.subtitle: Cinematic strings & grand piano swell • Soaring emotions across the passage of time

scenes.name: Waqt Humein Aage Le Aaya
scenes.subtitle: Life gave everything else back • But never that world of our old school

lines.text: Ek ghanti thi, sau kahaaniyan,
Ek bench thi, poora jahaan,
Waqt humein aage le aaya,
Dil reh gaya classroom mein wahaan...
Woh chhote se sapne, woh befikr samaa,
Woh roothna, manana, woh apna gumaaan,
Zindagi mein sab kuchh dobara mila,
Par na mila woh school wala jahaan...
Ek ghanti thi, sau kahaaniyan, Kuchh dost the, poora jahaan,
Hum bade ho gaye, zamaana badal gaya,
Dil reh gaya classroom mein wahaan...

scenes.name: Piano Drift & Puraane Doston
scenes.subtitle: Meet me there someday, old friends • Some conversations are still waiting to finish

lines.text: Kabhi milna wahin, puraane doston...
Kuchh baatein abhi bhi adhoori hain...
Woh bench ab bhi hogi, woh kamra bhi hoga,
Shaayad kisi aur ka bachpan wahaan hoga...

scenes.name: Aur Hum Toh Ghar Tak Aa Gaye
scenes.subtitle: We walked all the way back home • But our hearts remained forever in that classroom

lines.text: Aur hum...
Hum toh ghar tak aa gaye...
Dil reh gaya classroom mein wahaan...
